task: Add a team git repository delivery target to `codemie analytics sync` beside the webhook: prompt-free clone/commit/push with the developer's own credentials, rebase-retry, per-target markers, configurable branch/path, and status/uninstall/bootstrap support.

key_reasoning.reason: Every sync runner (install, run-sync, status, uninstall), the settings store, types, marker and run-log grammar assume one webhook target and one marker by documented design; all must generalize to N targets, plus a new git target abstraction (clone/commit/rebase/push, persistent working copy under the CodeMie home), CLI wiring and sync error classes. Base L, bumped for integration with a new external system (team git remote).

AC are detailed, but two AC depend on code absent from this branch and from origin: the `bootstrap` command (EPMCDME-16487) and the flattened OTel export format (EPMCDME-16561). Per-target marker/window design versus collector-compatible single marker is an open design decision, as is the multi-target run-log grammar consumed by status.

Closest pattern is `skills/add.ts` non-interactive git (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT, GCM_INTERACTIVE env + timeout); it covers HTTPS prompts only, not SSH passphrase / unknown host-key prompts (BatchMode, StrictHostKeyChecking), credential redaction of `user:token@` URLs (redactSecrets strips only `sig=`), or cross-platform credential helpers. Rebase-retry concurrency, dirty-clone recovery and bounded git timeouts under schedulers without time limits are novel. Base L, bumped for credential/security sensitivity.

About 12 modified source/doc files (types, config-store, marker, run-sync, status, install, uninstall, format, redact, analytics/index.ts, utils/errors.ts, docs/ANALYTICS-REPORT.md) plus 6+ existing test files (run-sync, install, status, uninstall, config-store, CLI surface), and 3-4 new files (git target, git command helper, their tests): 16+ modified -> XXL.

CLI surface, Service (runners), Persistence (settings schema with optional webhook, per-target marker layout, run log), Infrastructure (scheduled job behavior, working copy under ~/.codemie), External (developer git binary, credential helpers, SSH agent, remote host). Base L, bumped for the new external integration.

Project L anchor profile-provider-decoupling (23) had similar file breadth but no external integration or security-sensitive novelty; bundle XL anchor epmcdme-10303 (27, new external service with credentials) matches this task's profile. Raw total lands exactly on the 26/27 boundary; Technical Risk and Component Scope are both XL, so it leans higher.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: integration with a new external system (team git remote via developer's git binary)
Affected Layers bumped from L to XL: integration with a new external system

Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: security-sensitive credential handling (prompt-free git auth, never storing tokens, redacting credentials in URLs) with no existing pattern covering SSH/host-key prompts or URL credential redaction

split_recommendation.ordering_note: All work is in the codemie repo; land the multi-target foundation first, then the git target on top. The bootstrap AC (EPMCDME-16487) and OTel-format file naming AC (EPMCDME-16561) have no code on this branch; defer them to follow-ups after those stories merge rather than building them here.

slices.title: Multi-target sync foundation
slices.scope: Generalize analytics sync from one webhook to a list of targets: optional webhook in settings and validation, per-target last-sent markers and windows (keeping the collector-compatible webhook marker), a per-target run-log grammar that status still parses, and status/uninstall that iterate targets. Webhook remains the only implemented target; behaviour unchanged for existing installs.

slices.title: Git repository delivery target
slices.scope: Add the git target: install flags for repository, branch and relative path with a test push before scheduling, prompt-free clone/commit/rebase-retry/push using the developer's own credentials with bounded timeouts, report file under the developer's email-slug folder, credential-redacted status for the repository, and uninstall removal of the local working copy.
